response.rationale: Recurrent obstructive symptoms with bowel dilation but no mechanical cause on laparotomy indicates intestinal pseudo-obstruction; fat-soluble vitamin losses are secondary to bacterial overgrowth/malabsorption rather than short bowel syndrome, for which no resection is described.

rejected.why: No history of bowel resection or short bowel anatomy; weight loss and fat-soluble vitamin deficiencies are nonspecific and better explained by pseudo-obstruction with malabsorption.
